decisions: The product is CSV-first because Tally, Zoho, Busy, ClearTax and Excel can all export CSV without a portal integration.
The engine is offline and deterministic: every exception comes from a named rule in lib.mjs, so the same inputs and tolerance produce the same matches and amounts.
The skill is positioned as data preparation and exception review, not tax advice, eligibility determination or filing.
Matching normalises invoice punctuation (INV/001 and INV-001 are the same key) to handle real exports, but the original source value is retained in exceptions.csv for review.
Duplicates are flagged separately from match status so a duplicate can still match GSTR-2B while remaining visible for review.
Potential ITC at risk is the tax on missing-in-2B rows plus positive value differences; it is explicitly a review amount, not a confirmed loss.
Credit notes, reverse charge, imports, ISD, section 17(5) blocking and multi-currency are excluded from v1 rather than silently misclassified.
unresolved: Owner approval for final pricing, licence terms, support terms, storefront, fulfilment and publication.
Demand has not been validated through interviews, pre-orders or pilots.
Windows and Node.js 18 execution have not been tested; only macOS with Node.js 25.9.0 is verified.
Client-IDE installation and activation in Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or other hosts has not been tested.
Large-file performance has not been benchmarked.
Legal sufficiency and tax-positioning review have not been independently validated.
evidence: Demo: 7 books rows, 7 GSTR-2B rows, 6 matched, 1 missing-in-2B, 1 missing-in-books, 1 value mismatch, 1 date mismatch; potential ITC at risk 1890; potential unclaimed 900; match rate 85.71.
Messy: 2 duplicate books rows, 1 invalid GSTIN checksum, 2 missing-in-2B rows; potential ITC at risk 2700; match rate 50.
CLI strict mode exits 1 on exceptions; non-strict mode exits 0; invalid input exits 2.
Scripts import only node: built-ins and local modules; zero runtime dependencies, no network calls and no API keys.
validate-product reports 0 failures; validate-skill-readiness reports 0 failures; audit-package reports 0 failures and 45 safe entries.
